translations.vi: Tòa nhà đã bị thiêu rụi.

translations.en: Our house looks like it's going to burn!
translations.es: ¡Parece que nuestra casa va a arder!
translations.fr: Notre maison a l’air sur le point de brûler !
translations.de: Unser Haus sieht aus, als würde es brennen!
translations.it: La nostra casa sembra sul punto di bruciare!
translations.zh-Hans: 我们的房子看起来快要着火了！
translations.yue: 我哋間屋睇嚟就好似要火燒咁！
translations.pt: Nossa casa parece que vai pegar fogo!
translations.he: הבית שלנו נראה כאילו עומד להישרף!
translations.vi: Ngôi nhà của chúng tôi có vẻ như sẽ bị cháy!
translations.nl: Ons huis lijkt te gaan branden!
translations.hu: Úgy néz ki, mintha a házunk le fog égni!
translations.hi: हमारा घर ऐसा लग रहा है जैसे यह जलने वाला है!
translations.pl: Wygląda na to, że nasz dom zaraz spłonie!
translations.el: Το σπίτι μας φαίνεται ότι θα καεί!
translations.nb: Huset vårt ser ut til å brenne!
translations.sv: Vårt hus ser ut att brinna ner!
translations.ro: Casa noastră pare că o să ardă!
translations.da: Vores hus ser ud til at brænde!

tokens.explanation: Indicates the house (home) that appears to be in danger of burning.
Marks 'うち' as the subject of the verb.
Stem of the intransitive verb '焼ける', used to attach 'そう'.
Indicates that the action appears likely.
Informal copula stating the sentence.

sentences.target: 火事でうちが焼けています！
sentences.reading: かじでうちがやけています！

translations.en: Our house is burning in the fire!
translations.es: ¡Nuestra casa está ardiendo en el fuego!
translations.it: La nostra casa sta bruciando nel fuoco!
translations.vi: Ngôi nhà của chúng tôi đang cháy trong đám cháy!
translations.nl: Ons huis staat in brand in de brand!
translations.hi: हमारा घर आग में जल रहा है!
translations.el: Το σπίτι μας καίγεται στη φωτιά!

tokens.explanation: Refers to the event of a fire.
Marks the cause or reason ('because of a fire').
The speaker's house that's burning.
Marks 'うち' as the subject undergoing the action.
Te-form of '焼ける', connecting to the progressive aspect.
Polite auxiliary indicating an ongoing action.

sentences.target: ぼくのうちはぜんぶ焼けてしまった。
sentences.reading: ぼくのうちはぜんぶやけてしまった。

translations.en: My house has completely burned down.
translations.es: Mi casa se ha quemado por completo.
translations.it: La mia casa è completamente bruciata.
translations.vi: Nhà tôi đã bị thiêu rụi hoàn toàn.
translations.hi: मेरा घर पूरी तरह से जल गया है।
translations.el: Το σπίτι μου έχει καεί ολοσχερώς.
translations.nb: Huset mitt har brent helt ned.
translations.sv: Mitt hus har brunnit ner helt.
translations.da: Mit hus er fuldstændig brændt ned.

tokens.explanation: First-person pronoun referring to the speaker.
Possessive marker linking 'ぼく' and 'うち'.
The speaker's house.
Marks 'ぼくのうち' as the topic of the sentence.
Indicates that everything was affected.
Te-form of '焼ける', leading to the completion auxiliary.
Expresses completion with a sense of regret.

sentences.target: つぎのいえはもう焼けません！
sentences.reading: つぎのいえはもうやけません！

translations.en: The next house will never burn again!
translations.es: ¡La próxima casa nunca volverá a arder!
translations.fr: La prochaine maison ne brûlera plus jamais !
translations.de: Das nächste Haus wird nie wieder brennen!
translations.it: La prossima casa не brucerà mai più!
translations.ko: 다음 집은 다시는 불타지 않을 거야!
translations.zh-Hans: 下一栋房子再也不会着火了！
translations.yue: 隔壁屋永遠都唔會再燒！
translations.ru: Следующий дом больше никогда не сгорит!
translations.pt: A próxima casa никогда mais vai queimar!
translations.he: הבית הבא לעולם לא יישרף שוב!
translations.tr: Bir sonraki ev bir daha asla yanmayacak!
translations.vi: Ngôi nhà tiếp theo sẽ không bao giờ cháy nữa!
translations.ar: المنزل التالي لن يحترق مرة أخرى!
translations.nl: Het volgende huis zal nooit meer branden!
translations.uk: Наступний будинок більше ніколи не згорить!
translations.hu: A következő ház soha többé nem ég fel!
translations.hi: अगला घर फिर कभी नहीं जलेगा!
translations.pl: Następny dom już nigdy nie spłonie!
translations.el: Το επόμενο σπίτι δεν θα καεί ποτέ ξανά!
translations.nb: Det neste huset vil aldri brenne igjen!
translations.id: Rumah berikutnya tidak akan pernah terbakar lagi!
translations.sv: Nästa hus kommer aldrig att brinna igen!
translations.ro: Următoarea casă nu va mai arde niciodată!
translations.da: Det næste hus vil aldrig brænde igen!
translations.fi: Seuraava talo ei pala enää koskaan!

tokens.explanation: Indicates the subsequent item in sequence.

Marks 'つぎのいえ' as the topic.
Indicates that the action will not occur anymore.
Stem of '焼ける', used to form polite negative.
